notes: Synthetic clips generated with `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2 + sine`.
Each row is a single wall-clock measurement of merge_videos() end-to-end including normalize + concat passes.
Phase rows are merges of 3 clips with that single feature toggled on; compare against 3-clip baseline (interpolated from 2→5 ≈ 1.0s).
Captions (Phase 4) intentionally not measured here — would dominate wall clock with model load + transcription. Captured separately in `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` Phase 4 section.
